title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This note reads the engines' own state from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Every position here is paper, and 1 trade says nothing about a strategy.

## What is open

The live snapshot shows 0 positions open on paper in htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. A count of 0 means the engine currently holds no paper position. It does not mean the engine is disabled, and it does not mean a future entry is impossible. It is simply the current state of the running record. Separately, a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.

- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper.
- NEAR: A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.

The record therefore contains an open entry at 5.896 alongside 0 open paper positions in the engines named above. This is a state reading, not a verdict on any engine.

## Closed trades and the recorded live signal

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The recorded live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That closed trade is a realized paper loss. The entry was at 2.066 and the exit was at 1.703, so both recorded prices are closing prices from the log.

htf-rsi-v007 has 5 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The trend-daily averages are net per trade, so they are recorded net figures for those engines. htf-rsi-v007 shows average null net per trade, which means the record does not present a nonzero average for those 5 trades.

In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The closed-trade averages are negative, and the record does not convert that into a claim about future performance.

- ATOM: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close; exit at 1.703 at the 18 October 2026 close; −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- htf-rsi-v007: 5 closed trades so far; average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 6 closed trades so far; average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 7 closed trades so far; average -13.34% net per trade.

## Market filter and distance to breakout

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With the filter off, the record shows 0 positions open on paper for both engines. The Bitcoin market filter being off is a state of the filter, not a forecast. It means the filter is not currently allowing the trend-daily entries described by these engines.

The closest names to their 20-day breakout are also recorded. For trend-daily-v005, TRXUSDT is 12.57% below its high, AAVEUSDT is 16.30% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 17.87% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, JUPUSDT is 6.80% below its high, TRXUSDT is 12.57% below its high, and AAVEUSDT is 16.30% below its high. These distances are measurements from each high. A smaller distance means a closer approach to the breakout level, but distance alone does not determine whether a breakout happens.

- trend-daily-v005: Bitcoin market filter is off; TRXUSDT 12.57% below its high; AAVEUSDT 16.30% below its high; XLMUSDT 17.87% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006: Bitcoin market filter is off; JUPUSDT 6.80% below its high; TRXUSDT 12.57% below its high; AAVEUSDT 16.30% below its high.

## Where the record lives

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-18T09:20:37.675Z. The record updates continuously, so a later read can show different open positions, closed trades, and filter states. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. Nothing here is a recommendation, and nothing here predicts a price.
